expectations.text: Matching status or diff statistics are not accepted as proof that relevant content is unchanged.
expectations.evidence: Calls the ledger a hint and rejects HEAD/status/diff-stat as content identity.

expectations.text: A committed HEAD is required before the commit-range SDD workflow proceeds.
expectations.evidence: Stops the commit-range workflow if HEAD verification fails.

expectations.text: Plan, relevant files, explicit inputs, and checkpoint commits are reconciled using content-sensitive evidence.
expectations.evidence: Checks plan digest, task commit range, file digest, and run-context, but does not explicitly revalidate every recorded extra input.

expectations.text: Affected inspection or verification is rerun when unchanged state cannot be established cheaply.
expectations.evidence: Uses targeted inspection and affected verification.
